item.name: Prefix stripped, POST body and query preserved

exec: pm.test("Expected response", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.path).to.eql("/echo"); pm.expect(b.method).to.eql("POST"); pm.expect(b.query.tag).to.eql(["a","b"]); pm.expect(JSON.parse(b.body)).to.deep.eql({message:"routed"}); });

item.name: Proxy concurrency (both running)
item.description: Both services must be running and idle. Defaults: users_limit=2, catalog_limit=2, saturation_delay_ms=1000; header timeout must exceed that delay. Each saturation request sends an asynchronous burst and verifies exact admissions, immediate 503s, other-service availability and independent health. Run folder sequentially, not individual burst items in parallel.

item.name: Saturate users; reject excess and keep catalog available
users capacity is reusable after the burst

exec: pm.test("Service accepts work after burst completion", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: Saturate catalog; reject excess and keep users available
catalog capacity is reusable after the burst

exec: pm.test("Service accepts work after burst completion", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: Proxy priorities (both running)
item.description: Default local configuration: total 2, reserved_critical 1 for users/catalog. Base routes are critical; /users/background and /catalog/background are background. Requires idle services and 0 < reservation < total. Run M2 concurrency first to verify critical work can borrow all shared capacity.

item.name: users priority reservation and shared total limit
users background and critical capacity recover
catalog priority reservation and shared total limit
catalog background and critical capacity recover
